data.rationale: The proposal captures the core procedure (optional Filters, type destination, click FIND A KOA, optional dates), but it adds a spurious second step of selecting a campground and clicking FIND A KOA again. It also narrows the filter to "site type" and puts the dates after the search, which makes the spec partly ambiguous to automate.
